channel.title: The Kimberley Echo - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kimberley Echo (kimberleyecho.com.au)

item.title: Durack community organisations urged to apply for vollie grant funding
item.description: Community organisations throughout the Pilbara are being urged to apply for Federal funding aimed at boosting support for volunteers.

item.title: Kimberley’s rural clinicians connect
item.description: The Kimberley Health Professionals Network has kicked off the year with a welcome event in Broome, designed to support rural clinicians and strengthen the region’s health workforce

item.title: Broome man charged with family and domestic assault
item.description: Detectives from the Kimberley District have charged a man with several offences following an investigation into family violence related incidents spanning nearly two decades

item.title: Aboriginal officers in Fitzroy Crossing honoured with police service medals
item.description: Four former Aboriginal Police Liaison Officers and Police Officers from Fitzroy Crossing recognised for their service, receiving Aboriginal Police Service Medals at a ceremony

item.title: Broome Chamber’s summit highlights $1.5 billion Kimberley project pipeline
item.description: Major Projects Summit brought together leaders from industry, government, Traditional Owner organisations and local enterprises to map out the Kimberley’s development pipeline for the decade ahead

item.title: Mineral Resources’ support for Shooting Stars assured for three more years with $600,000 partnership extension
item.description: A three-year support promise has been given to a program that combines advocacy, health, wellbeing and cultural identity to empower young Pilbara and Kimberley to make informed choices.

item.title: Water Corp refutes contamination concerns after shire order for independent testing
item.description: The Water Corporation has denied there is any potential for wastewater contamination of drinking water in Kununurra and Wyndham after the local shire greenlit an independent review of potable water sources.

item.title: Shire of Wyndham East Kimberley welcomes new citizens into the fold
item.description: The Shire of Wyndham East Kimberley has welcomed 12 new Australian citizens into the fold during a citizenship ceremony last week.

item.title: Shire of Wyndham-East Kimberley rejects compulsory voting and four-year election cycles
item.description: Shire of Wyndham-East Kimberley councillors have voted against State Government plans to introduce compulsory voting and four-year election cycles for local governments.

item.title: Derby’s Callum Ah Chee hopeful to play round one despite hamstring strain
item.description: Derby-born two-time AFL premiership player Callum Ah Chee is racing the clock to be fit for round one after a minor hamstring strain suffered during last month’s State of Origin clash.
